source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid[0])
    center = next(c for c, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value == 2)
    out = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in (center - r, center + r):
            if 0 <= c < n:
                out[r][c] = 2
        for c in range(n):
            if abs(c - center) < r and (c - r - center) % 4 == 0:
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
